series.description: Corresponds to y-axis values, plus unit.  Multiple series are represented as array of arrays.

xAxisType.description: The type of xAxis data, category or timeseries.

missing.description: Indicates how much missing data there is for each of the sets of values in series.

title:
A generic type to hold chart data.
Transformers that have the name "From" are assumed to transform data from
some other format into this type.
Transformers that have the name "To" are assumed to transform data from
this type to some other format.
name: UiSdlChartData
